property_summary: The transfer function should return true when it completes successfully.
Calling transfer with valid inputs should return the same boolean value as the reference implementation
Calling transfer with the same inputs and the contract returning a value does not revert and returns the same boolean as the reference when the call succeeds.
The transfer function always returns true when it does not revert.
transfer function returns true when it completes without reverting
The transfer function does not revert for any valid input
After calling transfer with non-empty _tos and v = 0, the balance of caddress remains unchanged for any from and any to addresses.
The transfer function must revert only if the inner call reverts, not unconditionally.
After calling transfer with at least one recipient, the return value is true for the reference implementation.
After calling transfer, the return value is true if _tos is non-empty and all inner calls succeed.
The transfer function should succeed when _tos array has elements and revert when it is empty.
The transfer function should not revert when _tos has elements.
The transfer function must succeed (return true) when the _tos array has elements, regardless of the other parameter values.
The transfer function must not revert when _tos.length > 0.
The transfer function must succeed (not revert) when _tos has one element and the external call returns success, but revert when _tos has exactly one element and a zero recipient address

After a call to transfer with the given parameters, the function should revert if _tos.length is zero, and always return true; the buggy version never reverts for zero-length arrays due to the loop condition change.
After a call to transfer with a non-empty _tos array, the function returns true.
After a call to transfer with a non-empty _tos array, the function reverts if any call in the loop fails; the buggy version never reverts because the loop never executes.
After a call to transfer, the function reverts if the loop body would revert; the buggy version never reverts because the loop never executes.
After a call to transfer with a non-empty _tos array, the function returns true.
For any array of recipients, transfer returns true (i.e., all external calls succeed).
After calling transfer with the same arguments, the return value is always true.
If the array of recipients contains the same address as 'from', the call does not revert (i.e., transfer returns true).
For any caller (msg.sender), after calling transfer with from, caddress, tos, and v, the function does not revert (returns true) and the balance of the caller remains the same as before the call.
For any from, caddress, tos, and v, calling transfer returns true and the function does not revert.
